entities.summary: Jérôme-Adolphe Blanqui was a French economist. His most important contributions were made in labour economics, economic history, and especially the history of economic thought, in which field his 1837 treatise has been the first major work. He was a disciple of Jean-Baptiste Say to whom he succeeded in 1833 to the chair of political economy at the Conservatoire des Arts et Métiers, and a free trader.

entities.summary: Jérôme-Adolphe Blanqui was a French economist. His most important contributions were made in labour economics, economic history, and especially the history of economic thought, in which field his 1837 treatise has been the first major work. He was a disciple of Jean-Baptiste Say to whom he succeeded in 1833 to the chair of political economy at the Conservatoire des Arts et Métiers, and a free trader.
